    invite = TeamInvite.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",)).with_team().filter(pk=invite.pk).first()
    if invite is None: return
    team = invite.team
    team.members.add(user)
    team.organiser.log_action("pretalx.invite.orga.accept", person=user, orga=True)
    invite.delete()
